crossRefs.note: Be glad in Yahweh, and rejoice, you righteous! Shout for joy, all you who are upright in heart!
Rejoice in Yahweh, you righteous! Praise is fitting for the upright.
Tell the righteous “Good!” For they shall eat the fruit of their deeds.
You will show me the path of life. In your presence is fullness of joy. In your right hand there are pleasures forever…
Surely goodness and loving kindness shall follow me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in Yahweh’s house forever.
You will guide me with your counsel, and afterward receive me to glory.
If I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again, and will receive you to myself; that where I am, you may be…
Father, I desire that they also whom you have given me be with me where I am, that they may see my glory, which you…
then we who are alive, who are left, will be caught up together with them in the clouds, to meet the Lord in the air.…

The nations will walk in its light. The kings of the earth bring the glory and honor of the nations into it.

translations.web: Surely the righteous will give thanks to your name. The upright will dwell in your presence.
translations.bsb: Surely the righteous will praise Your name; the upright will dwell in Your presence.
translations.kjv: Surely the righteous shall give thanks unto thy name: the upright shall dwell in thy presence.
translations.asv: Surely the righteous shall give thanks unto thy name: The upright shall dwell in thy presence. Psalm 141 A Psalm of David.
